title: bomify plugin RemoteResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout on success for its "remote" subcommand, per plugins/COMPONENT-CONTRACT.md. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one object) against this schema to check it for structural conformance.

remote.description: Where the component comes from or is published under, in whatever shape is meaningful for this plugin's kind (a registry/repository address, a source URL, etc.).
